changelog:
- Initial release of yt-mem-ai skill as the unified entry point for all YouTube pipeline CLI operations.
- Supports ingesting videos, subscription discovery, batch fetch, channel enumeration, search, rating/recommendation, compilation, supercut creation, and status checks.
- All data operations route through the CLI (`uvx yt-mem-ai <cmd>`); direct LanceDB interaction is not allowed.
- Includes global configuration management, preference for CLI config commands over `.env` or environment variables.
- Summarization and analysis are delegated to [[yt-agent]]; skill itself handles storage and orchestration.
- Provides robust handling and guidance for common YouTube fetch errors and pipeline conventions.
summary: Use when the user wants to run any yt-ai operation from Claude Code — ingest a video, discover subscription uploads, batch-fetch pending, search the library, rate/recommend, compile highlights, build a supercut, check status, or run a full pipeline (daily routine or single-video). The umbrella entry point for the yt-mem-ai CLI; delegates per-video analysis, digests, and reviews to [[yt-agent]].
